book.name: Yohanes
book.title: Lele Pore Men Ia Tadulkon I YOHANES

content: Ramean posuo'an na Kana
Koi itulunna isian posuo'an na kota Kana men na Galilea, ka' sina ni Yesus uga' isian indo'o.
Yesus tia murit-Na uga' nibantili na posuo'an iya'a.
Sarataa anggur na posuo'an iya'a nokabusmo, sina ni Yesus norobumo na Ko'ona taena, “Anggurna i raaya'a nokabusmo.”
Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Mama, kadai se' i kuu morobu koiya'a na Ingku'. Sianpo taka tempona i Yaku' mimpipiile'kon wawaung-Ku.”
Kasee sina ni Yesus norobu na mian men balimang taena, “Wawau a upa men bantilkonon ni Yesus na ko'omuu.”
Na posuo'an iya'a isian gumbang nonoom men nitoropoti bo pimbuu'an gause koiya'a a adatna Yahudi. Sanda' gumbang iya'a isiina toro sa'atu liter.
Yesus norobumo na mian men balimang tae-Na, “Isiimo tia weer a gumbang karaanono'.” Mbaka' ia isiimo i raaya'a pataka nobuke'.
Kasi i Yesus norobu na ko'ona tae-Na, “Alaka' tauk a weer kanono' titiu' ka' wawakon na tanaasna ramean.” Mbaka' ia wawakonmo i raaya'a a weer iya'a na tanaasna ramean,

kasi ia inum a weer iya'a men nosidamo anggur. (Kasee tanaas iya'a sian ninginti'i nangalaan anggur iya'a, tongko' mian balimang men nantauk weer iya'a men daa ninginti'i.) Mbaka' tanaasna ramean iya'a nuntuu'imo moro'one men mosuo',
ka' norobu taena, “Mansanda' mian mantaropkon olukon anggur men pore ka' kalu sawe' bangarmo kasi anggur men sian laan pore. Kasee i kuu nanganaa' anggur men porena tuu' pataka koini'i!”

Ya'amo a upa kosamba' men tumbena tuu' ia wawau i Yesus. Ia nangawawau iya'a na Kana men na Galilea. Wawau kosamba' iya'a niwawau bookoi oosan men mompopo'inti'ikon kobalaki'an-Na. Mbaka' murit-Na noparasayamo na Ko'ona.
Noko daa posuo'an iya'a, Yesus tia sina-Na, utus-Na, ka' murit-Na nomae'mo na Kapernaum. Raaya'a nodumodongo indo'o toro pii ilio.
Yesus sian nomoturang mian mobaluk na Laiganna Alaata'ala.
Torumpak ilio ramean Paska na lipu' Yahudi, Yesus nomae'mo na Yerusalem.
Na tolodona Laiganna Alaata'ala na Yerusalem, Ia nantakai mian mobaluk sapi', domba, marampatii, ka' uga' mian men totolosi doi' poto'oruang iraando'o.

Yesus nangalamo lui' bo pembebot ka' nangaraap i raaya'a giigii' tia domba ka' sapi' men isian na tolodona Laiganna Alaata'ala iya'a. Giigii' mejana mian totolosi doi' Ia tua-tua'kon tamban doi'na i raaya'a notampaas na tano'.
Kasi Ia norobu na mian men mobaluk marampatii tae-Na, “Uarkon giigii' iraanono'. Alia minsidakon Laiganna Tamang-Ku bo pobalukanmuu!”
Mbaka' murit-Na tinonginau'mo isiina Alkitaap men taena, “Lingu'-Ku na Laigan-Muu Alaata'ala, minsidakon munsuap noang-Ku.”
Moomoola'na Yahudi nanggagai i Yesus taena i raaya'a, “Kalu i Koo ia tarai Alaata'ala kuasa bo pinginti'i Laigan-Na kani'i, alaka' pangawawau upa kosamba' bo oosanmai.”
Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Runtuni a Laigan kani'i, ka' tongko' tolu' ilio pokereron-Kumo soosoodo.”
Kasi taena i raaya'a, “Laiganna Alaata'ala kani'i tiodaa patompulo' ka' nonoom taun mbali' daa poko nipokerer. Se' daa i Koo mangaan bo momokerer tongko' tolu' ilio?”
Kasee panduung ni Yesus mangaan Laiganna Alaata'ala mase waka-Na suung-Na.

Sarataa i Yesus nipotuo'i noko daa lapus, kasi notonginau' a murit-Na se' iya'a Ia poko bantilkonmo mbaripian. Mbaka' i raaya'a noparasayamo na upa men nitulis na Alkitaap ka' upa men ia bantilkonmo i Yesus.
Yesus minginti'i noana giigii' mian
Na tempo i Yesus na Yerusalem, na ilio ramean Paska, biai' a mian men nosida parasaya na Ko'ona gause nimiile' upa kosamba' ka' sian dele men Ia wawau.
Kasee i Yesus sian mongooskon kaparasaya'anna mian na Ko'ona, gause Ia minginti'i a noana giigii' mian.
Ka' mian mosoo mompopo'inti'ikon na Ko'ona gau'na mian sambana, gause Ia minginti'i noana giigii' mian.
